question: Should OpenClaw permanently retain trajectory runtime events for 14 days and 512 MiB per agent database, with the active session exempt from global eviction?
rationale: These hard-coded values intentionally trade historical diagnostic availability for bounded persistent storage, and the linked report itself identified retention as an observability product decision.

options.title: Approve the bounded policy
options.body: Accept the proposed 14-day and 512 MiB limits after reviewing real after-fix evidence and treat the limits as the supported diagnostic-retention contract.

options.title: Choose different limits
options.body: Keep the global-retention approach but set different age or byte limits based on the expected support and observability window.

options.title: Split payload reduction from deletion
options.body: Land prompt-size reduction separately while deferring database-wide event deletion until the retention policy is agreed.

recommendation.title: Approve the bounded policy
recommendation.body: Accept the proposed 14-day and 512 MiB limits after reviewing real after-fix evidence and treat the limits as the supported diagnostic-retention contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The linked report and proposed branch contain the available concrete rationale for the retention thresholds.
